title: Federal Income Tax Payments by Income Percentile
notes: Note: There were roughly 153.1 million total federal income tax filers in 2023. Total adjusted gross income (AGI) was roughly $15.2 trillion. The top 1% of earners have AGI above $675,602; the top 5% have AGI above $272,209; the top 10% have AGI above $187,608; the top 25% have AGI above $105,604; and the top 50% have AGI above $53,801.
source: Source: Tax Foundation, "Summary of the Latest Federal Income Tax Data, Tax Year 2023"; IRS, Statistics of Income Division.
